words.meaning: A deep, pensive, and long-lasting sadness
words.sentence1: She felt a quiet melancholy as the autumn leaves began to fall (She felt a quiet melancholy as the autumn leaves began to fall).
words.sentence2: The old photograph filled him with a sweet melancholy (The old photograph filled him with a sweet melancholy).

words.meaning: A sentimental longing or affectionate yearning for the past
words.sentence1: Escuchar esa canción vieja me trajo mucha nostalgia (Listening to that old song brought me a lot of nostalgia).
words.sentence2: Había una nota de nostalgia en su voz al recordar su infancia (There was a note of nostalgia in his voice when remembering his childhood).

words.meaning: A feeling of tenderness or being touched emotionally
words.sentence1: Un sentiment d'attendrissement l'envahit en voyant le petit chaton (A feeling of tenderness overcame him upon seeing the little kitten).
words.sentence2: Elle regardait son grand-père avec un sourire d'attendrissement (She looked at her grandfather with a smile of tenderness).

words.meaning: An intense longing or yearning for a person, place, or feeling
words.sentence1: Er spürte eine tiefe Sehnsucht nach seiner Heimat (He felt a deep yearning for his homeland).
words.sentence2: Ihre Augen waren voller Sehnsucht, als sie in die Ferne blickte (Her eyes were full of longing as she looked into the distance).

words.meaning: A poignant, bittersweet sadness or painful yearning in the heart
words.sentence1: Kono uta wa mune ni setsunasa o kanji saseru (This song makes one feel a poignant sadness in the chest).
words.sentence2: Kare no kōkai no naka ni setsunasa ga atta (There was a bittersweet yearning amidst his regret).

words.meaning: A deep emotional stirring, moving emotion, or touch of sentiment
words.sentence1: Gli occhi le si inumidirono per la commozione (Her eyes watered with emotion).
words.sentence2: Il suo discorso ha suscitato grande commozione tra il pubblico (His speech stirred great emotion among the audience).

words.meaning: Deeply moved, touched, or emotionally stirred
words.sentence1: Ta de hua rang wo hen gandong (What she said made me very moved).
words.sentence2: Zhege gushi jianzhi ling ren gandong (This story is simply touching).

words.meaning: A feeling of slight disappointment, emotional coldness, or emptiness
words.sentence1: Chinguga nae illak-eul sibeochaeseo seorseorham-i deul-eotda (I felt a bit hurt and disappointed when my friend ignored my message).
words.sentence2: Geu mal-eun naege keun seorseorham-eul namgillaeji anhassda (Those words left a subtle sting of disappointment in me).

words.meaning: A state of emotional grief, sorrow, or heavy-hearted sadness
words.sentence1: Koan-neak ban chol-job knong kar sok_sacheat yureuy (She experienced deep sorrow for a long time).
words.sentence2: Kbar-chnanh robos koan-neak ban banh-jenh ampi sok_sacheat (His facial expression revealed a deep heartache).

words.meaning: Anxiety, fear, or profound uneasy dread
words.sentence1: Sy het 'n gevoel van diep angs voor die eksamen gehad (She felt a sense of deep anxiety before the exam).
words.sentence2: Die donker storm het by hom groot angs veroorsaak (The dark storm caused great anxiety within him).
